events.title: NOOSA Alive! Festival
events.description: A diverse 10-day arts and culture festival featuring theatre, music, dance, literature, comedy, and film across various Noosa venues, offering a mix of free and ticketed experiences.

events.title: Queensland Ballet In Noosa 2026
events.description: Queensland Ballet presents a performance in Noosa as part of the broader Noosa Alive! Festival, showcasing world-class ballet and contemporary dance.

events.title: ROBYN HOOD - 1922 (Silent Film)
events.description: A screening of the classic 1922 silent film 'Robyn Hood' at the historic Majestic Theatre in Pomona, offering a unique cinematic experience in an authentic venue.

events.title: "HARVEST" THE HONEY SLIDERS
events.description: The Honey Sliders perform their 'Harvest' show at the intimate and historic Majestic Theatre in Pomona, known for supporting diverse musical acts.

events.title: Open Studios Sunshine Coast
events.location: Various locations, Sunshine Coast Hinterland & Coastline
events.description: Explore the studios of local artists across the Sunshine Coast Hinterland and coastline, offering a chance to see artists at work and engage directly with their creative process.
